components.name: Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells
components.reasoning: These cells are the fundamental photovoltaic component responsible for converting sunlight into electrical energy and are universally present as the core active element in all monocrystalline PV modules.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: The front tempered glass protects solar cells from environmental damage (hail, wind, debris) while allowing high light transmission, making it a universally standard component in almost all solar panels.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: The aluminum frame provides structural integrity and mounting support for the module, typically procured as a separate assembly and standard in most framed solar panels.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (Ethylene vinyl acetate, EVA)
components.reasoning: Encapsulant layers secure solar cells between the glass and backsheet, protecting them from moisture and mechanical stresses; EVA is industry standard and purchased as a distinct film or sheet.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: The backsheet provides electrical insulation and environmental protection at the rear of the module, commonly procured separately and essential for module durability.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: Mounted on the back of the module, it houses the electrical connections and bypass diodes; it is a distinct manufactured assembly critical for safe electrical integration.

components.name: Bypass Diodes (preassembled in junction box)
components.reasoning: Though integrated into the junction box assembly, bypass diodes are a critical electrical sub-component preventing power loss under shading, often sourced as distinct diode elements incorporated into the junction box.
